# Circle of the Riftwild

Most druids fear the Rift — it corrupts what they protect. Druids of the Riftwild see it differently. The Rift doesn't destroy nature. It transforms it. A riftwolf is still a wolf. A riftbear is still a bear. They've simply been touched by the deepest wild there is.

These druids don't resist the Rift. They let it in — partially. They become something between druid and riftbeast, capable of manifesting corrupted traits without surrendering themselves fully to the transformation.

## Hybrid Shift

*2nd-level Circle of the Riftwild feature*

You can spend a use of your Wild Shape to enter a hybrid form instead of fully transforming. In hybrid form, subtle riftbeast traits manifest — your eyes take on a violet tint, your skin hardens faintly, energy crackles along your limbs. You retain your humanoid shape and can still cast spells.

The transformation lasts for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). You can revert early as a bonus action.

While in hybrid form, your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 slashing damage using your Wisdom modifier for attack and damage rolls, and you have advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight — the Rift sharpens what it touches.

## Bestial Surge

*6th-level Circle of the Riftwild feature*

Your hybrid form deepens. As a bonus action while hybrid-shifted, you can manifest one of the following riftbeast traits. The trait remains active until you use this feature again to switch, or until your hybrid form ends.

**Phase-step.** You gain a 30-foot teleport as a bonus action. You briefly flicker through the Rift, appearing at your destination in a burst of violet light.

**Mauler's Hide.** You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Your skin takes on the thickened, energy-hardened quality of a riftbear.

**Charger's Pulse.** As an action, you can emit a disorienting pulse in a 10-foot radius. Creatures of your choice in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be knocked prone.

## Primal Surge

*10th-level Circle of the Riftwild feature*

Once per long rest, you can fully embrace the Rift within you. As a bonus action while in hybrid form, all three Bestial Surge traits activate simultaneously for 1 minute. Violet-black energy cascades off you. You are terrifying.

When the minute ends, you gain one level of exhaustion. The Rift gives, and the Rift takes.

## Elder Form

*14th-level Circle of the Riftwild feature*

Once per long rest, you can become something older than the Rift itself — or so it feels. Instead of hybrid shifting, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to transform into an Elder Riftbeast: a unique, ancient creature of the Severed Lands with lair actions and legendary resistances. Its Challenge Rating equals your druid level divided by 3 (rounded down).

The transformation lasts for 1 hour. The Elder Riftbeast's form and abilities are unique to your character — shaped by your experiences, your connection to the Rift, and the lands you've walked. Work with your DM to design your Elder Form.
